description: Experimental, not for merge. ASP.NET Core minimal API (the aspnet-minimal image) scaled out to 4 replicas behind one nginx edge that terminates TLS + h2, serves /static/* from disk and round-robins the dynamic endpoints over loopback HTTP/1.1. The replicas share 32 logical CPUs through 8-CPU quotas, 12g each and a 48-connection Npgsql pool each; compare with aspnet-minimal-gateway-8x4, which spends the same totals on the other split.
